newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cotton sales rise to 18,880 T - exporters.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cotton sales rise to 18,880 T - exporters.

text.p: Egyptian exporters said on Monday they had sold a total 18,879.5 tonnes (57,824 bales) of cotton one month into the export season.
Egypt expects to export between 125,000 and 150,000 tonnes of this year's harvest. Last week, exporters said they had sold a total of 15,508 tonnes.

The Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association (Alcotexa), which coordinates prices and exports by state-owned and private firms, said importers from 22 countries purchased the cotton and that Italy and Switzerland were still topping the list.
Alcotexa said it was rapidly running out of the Giza 86 variety and had raised prices three centilibres (U.S. cents per pound) on high demand.
Prices for the seven remaining varieties were unchanged, the association said.
